title: Fix Playground Showing Default Example When None Selected
description: The playground/example dropdown in the React OS shell (framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx) always forces the first registered example as the active example, even when no example was ever explicitly selected. The reconciliation useEffect at os-shell.tsx around activeExampleId cannot distinguish "no selection yet" (empty string) from "stale/removed selection", so it always falls back to exampleOptions[0]. Fix so that when no example is selected, the playground shows an empty/blank state (leveraging the existing NAVBAR_NO_EXAMPLE_ID sentinel in ui/js/react/index.tsx) instead of silently loading the default example, and remove the unused/duplicate NAVBAR_NO_EXAMPLE_ID constant in os-shell.tsx.
summary: Fixed the playground example dropdown in the React OS shell forcing exampleOptions[0] (effectively the "Default" example) as the active example whenever no example had been explicitly selected, which also caused the CAD/etc. plugin to keep displaying its boot-time default document. The reconciliation effect now only clears a stale selection (one that no longer exists in exampleOptions) back to empty instead of also overwriting a genuine "no selection yet" state. A second effect dispatches setActiveExample with an empty exampleId once per session instance when no example is selected, so plugins that support the blank/empty example id (e.g. cad) reset their document to a blank state instead of showing the default example. Removed the unused, stale local NAVBAR_NO_EXAMPLE_ID constant in os-shell.tsx that duplicated (with a different sentinel value) the one already exported from ui/js/react/index.tsx and used by NavbarExampleSelect. Verified in the cad-react-dev playground: fresh load now shows "No example" selected with a blank scene, and manually picking "Default" from the dropdown still loads it correctly.
